title: Passage 57
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: Here is the car of the future!
sentences.cn: 这就是未来的汽车！

sentences.en: This car is very different from today's cars: It is quiet and clean.
sentences.cn: 这辆车与如今的汽车截然不同：它安静且无污染。

sentences.en: Unlike the average car today, which has wheels, this one does not.
sentences.cn: 与现在普通的汽车不同，这辆车没有轮子。

sentences.en: It moves like a snail, but is much faster than a snail!
sentences.cn: 它像蜗牛一样移动，但速度却比蜗牛快得多！

sentences.en: This car will use electricity.
sentences.cn: 这辆汽车将由电力驱动。

sentences.en: It will use digital technology such as cameras to navigate.
sentences.cn: 它将使用摄像头等数字技术进行导航。

sentences.en: It will drive itself, like a robot.
sentences.cn: 它会像机器人一样自动驾驶。

sentences.en: You just need to tell it your destination, and the car will go there.
sentences.cn: 你只需要告诉它你的目的地，它就会自己开到那里。

sentences.en: Therefore, people who are often busy with work, such as presidents or lawyers,
sentences.cn: 因此，像总统或律师这样经常忙于工作的人，

sentences.en: are free to make phone calls on the way.
sentences.cn: 可以在途中自由地打电话。

sentences.en: And there will be self-driving 'taxis' available all day and night.
sentences.cn: 而且，未来还会有自动驾驶的出租车，全天候提供服务。

sentences.en: Also, due to its rapid movement, it will reach the location very quickly.
sentences.cn: 此外，由于其行驶速度很快，它将很快到达目的地。

sentences.en: It will also be very safe and comfortable — a smooth ride that feels like magic.
sentences.cn: 它还会非常安全舒适——平稳的乘车体验如同魔法一般。

sentences.en: Passengers can relax during the journey, perhaps reading a magazine, watching a movie,
sentences.cn: 乘客可以在旅途中放松，比如读杂志、看电影，

sentences.en: or playing games like an online version of ping-pong.
sentences.cn: 或者玩在线乒乓球之类的游戏。

sentences.en: The car can also reduce the risk of accidents,
sentences.cn: 这辆汽车还可以降低事故风险，

sentences.en: providing safe transport for firemen and police officers on their way to work.
sentences.cn: 为消防员和警察在工作途中提供安全的交通方式。

sentences.en: A lot of the technology has already appeared, but it is at the experimental stage.
sentences.cn: 很多这样的技术已经出现，但目前都还处于实验阶段。

sentences.en: As an exciting development, fifty years from now, some new roads will have solar panels for cars to use.
sentences.cn: 五十年后，一些新路面将配备供汽车使用的太阳能电池板，这是一个令人兴奋的发展趋势。

sentences.en: However, you won't be able to drive a 'snail car', even if you're under 20 today.
sentences.cn: 然而，即使你现在还不满20岁，也无法驾驶这样的“蜗牛汽车”了。

sentences.en: Maybe this is the car of the year 2100, and your grandchildren may drive it.
sentences.cn: 也许这会是2100年的汽车，你的孙辈可能会驾驶它。

sentences.en: No pollution, no traffic jams, and no stress.
sentences.cn: 没有污染，没有交通拥堵，没有压力。

sentences.en: It will be interesting to see what the cars look like many years from now.
sentences.cn: 多年后的汽车会是什么样子，让我们拭目以待。
